editorial: When waves kiss the shore, you find your own splash of adventure. Luca, a heartfelt 2D animated summer in the Italian Riviera, blends friendship and terror beneath turquoise tides. The texture of the water and the soundtrack by Anya Zidi capture the breeziness of beach life, while the reveal that Luca and Alberto are sea monsters feels fresh on the screen. However, the final stretch drags a bit, especially when the story lingers on the monsters’ folklore. You’ll love it if you’re after a family-friendly film that balances whimsy and gentle suspense.
targetAudience: Ideal for families and young viewers who enjoy heartfelt beach adventures.
